commentary.bulkers: German owners Blumenthal have acquired the Kamsarmax "King Barley" 82/2012 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS/DD 01/2022) from MK Centennial Maritime for mid-high USD 22 mill basis SS/DD passed and BWTS fitted. For comparison, the "SM Aurora" 82/2012 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 08/2022) was sold a couple of weeks ago for USD 21 mill basis delivery Q1 2022. Moreover, Kassian Maritime sold the sister vessels "Egyptian Mike" 81/2011 Guangzhou, China (SS 09/2026, DD 10/2024) & "George P" 81/2012 Guangzhou, China (SS/DD 08/2022) to compatriots Costamare for USD 39 mill enbloc. On the Supramax sector, Costamare also acquired the sister vessels "Belnor" 58/2010 Yangzhou, China (SS 05/2025, DD 05/2023, BWTS fitted) & "Belstar" 58/2009 Yangzhou, China (SS 08/2024, DD 07/2022, BWTS fitted) from Belships for USD 33 mill enbloc. Furthermore, the sisters "Universal Bangkok" 56/2012 Qingshan, China (SS/DD 04/2022) & "Universal Bremen" 56/2010 Qingshan, China (SS 12/2025, DD 01/2024, BWTS fitted) were committed to undisclosed buyers for USD 33 mill enbloc. Note that a month ago, the older sister vessel "Sophia N" 56/2009 Qingshan, China (SS 08/2024, DD 10/2022, BWTS fitted) was sold at USD 17,75 mill. In addition, Tomini Shipping sold their "Tomini Infinity" 56/2010 Cosco, China (SS 01/2025, DD 03/2023) for USD 16,2 mill basis delivery January-February 2022. Taylor Maritime have committed their OHBS Handysize "Super Lydia" 37/2007 Saiki, Japan (SS/DD 01/2022) to Turkish buyers for mid USD 13 mill, while the OHBS "AEC Diligence" 31/2002 Saiki, Japan (SS/DD 04/2022, BWTS fitted) was sold to Chinese buyers for USD 9,5 mill. Moreover, Meadway Shipping & Trading committed their "Targa" 28/2009 Imabari, Japan (SS 05/2024, DD 03/2022) for low USD 14 mill. Remind you that the "Atlantic Veracruz" 28/2009 Shimanami, Japan (SS/DD 07/2022) was sold a couple of weeks ago at USD 12,7 mill basis delivery January 2022.
commentary.tankers: Following their purchase through a judicial sale of the VLCC "E Mei San" 318/2010 SWS, China (SS 03/2025, DD 03/2023, BWTS fitted) from Xihe Holdings at USD 36,75 mill, Aeolos Management have now acquired the "New Coral" 297/2010 Shanghai Jiangnan, China (SS 01/2025, DD 05/2023, BWTS fitted) from China VLCC for USD 38,5 mill. Livanos Group have committed their MR2 "Evros" 47/2005 Stx, Korea (SS 01/2025, DD 12/2022) to Greek buyers for USD 9,4 mill, while the sister vessel "High Valor" 47/2005 Stx, Korea (SS 02/2025, DD 05/2023) from d'Amico Tankers was sold for USD 10,3 mill. For reference, d'Amico Tankers sold a month ago the one-year-younger "High Venture" 51/2006 Stx, Korea (SS 04/2026, DD 05/2024, BWTS fitted) at USD 10,7 mill.
